no_adcom_quote.quote: No Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee meeting was held for this application. Although trametinib is the first drug in its class, the clinical trial design was acceptable and the application raised no significant safety, efficacy or public health issues.

summary: No advisory committee meeting was convened for NDA204114 (MEKINIST / trametinib). The FDA review documents (Summary Review, Cross-Discipline Team Leader review, Office Director memo, and Medical Review) all explicitly state the application was not referred to the Oncologic Drugs Advisory Committee (ODAC) because the safety profile was acceptable, the efficacy trial design was acceptable and similar to prior approvals in the indication, and the application raised no significant safety, efficacy, or public health issues requiring outside expertise. Because no committee met, there are no committee-driven linkages to the approval.
